title: Passport
empty: No confirmed travel records for the passport yet.
needsFlights: The passport is built from your flights. Switch the Flights area on in settings to see it.
loadError: The passport could not be loaded.

summary.countriesTotalExplained: Countries visited counts actual stays. Ground presence also includes confirmed transit stops and travel through a country.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.headlineNote: {{counted}} visited · {{total}} with confirmed ground presence. Transit stops remain visible; uncertain visits are marked.
evidence.kindsSumNote: this split adds up to every country with evidence, not to the counted headline

tiers.sleptExplained: A stay or confirmed night outside pure transit places.
tiers.visitedExplained: A place visit, shore leave, home country or destination with return.
tiers.connectionExplained: The flight proves ground contact, not yet a visit.
tiers.transitedExplained: A recorded stopover or transit. Counts as ground contact, not a visit.

value.notApplicableEntries: Not applicable: no flight proves this country — not zero entries, but none there would be to count.
value.notApplicableAirports: Not applicable: no airport was used here.
value.unknownPeriod: Unknown: no record carries a date.
value.daysPresentExplained: Calendar days a record places you here. Does not decide the tier.
value.noDatedDays: 0 days: no record names a day (see “no date”).

ground.measuredExplained: Longest time on the ground between landing and next take-off. Does not decide the tier.
ground.unknownExplained: Unknown: a flight was here but no second one bounds the stay. Add the missing flight.
ground.notApplicableExplained: Not applicable: no flight touched this country.

provenance.intro: These records put the country in the passport. Each one opens the record — that is where you change it.
provenance.loadError: The records could not be loaded. That does not mean there are none.
provenance.truncated: Only the most recent records are shown.
provenance.none: No individual record available. The country belongs in the list all the same — there is simply no single record to open here.
provenance.trackNote: These Dawarich points prove no ground contact and are not counted.

continents.title: Continents
continents.denominator: Measured against the countries this catalogue knows — not against a total number of countries in the world, for which there is no agreed figure.

countries.title: Countries
countries.listNote: Ground presence includes confirmed transit stops and travel through a country. Select countries visited to show confirmed visits only.
countries.dashLegend: “—” does not mean zero, it means: not derivable.
countries.groundTimeLegend: Time on the ground: “unknown” can be filled in, “—” cannot.
countries.notCountedExplained: This country counts as ground presence. A visit beyond a transit stop is not established.
countries.undatedExplained: At least one record carries no date. This country therefore cannot appear in any year's figures.
countries.unclearResolve: A confirmed place, a stay or the missing flight settles it.

unclearReason.openChain: The recorded trip breaks off here (a one-way flight or ride, an open jaw, or the first or last trip).
unclearReason.noDestination: The trip never turns around – which country was the destination cannot be decided.
unclearReason.undated: The trip has no date and cannot be placed in a chain.

countries.dashLegendMore: A country proved only by a lodging or a port call has no flights and no airports — and without a dated record, no period either.
countries.groundTimeLegendMore: “unknown”: a flight was here but no second one bounds the stay. “—”: no flight was here at all. “Days” is always counted: 0 means no record names a day.

unconfirmed.title: Unconfirmed location days
unconfirmed.explanation: These Dawarich locations do not prove ground presence. They may come from overflights or inaccurate positions and do not add to country counts or days present. Confirmed place visits and travel records are counted independently.
unconfirmed.explanationLocation: These locations from your location history do not prove ground presence. They may come from overflights or inaccurate positions and do not add to country counts or days present. Confirmed place visits and travel records are counted independently.

countingRule: Ground contact includes changes. A visit needs a recorded stay.

verdict.visitedHint: Counts as a visited country — even without a record in your entries.
verdict.groundHint: Ground presence, but not a visit — a change of trains or a drive through, say.
verdict.excludedHint: The country leaves every figure. You can undo this at any time.

overrides.noteHint: Why? The note is shown with the country's records.
overrides.noteRequired: Please add a short note saying why.
overrides.dayHint: A day you remember. Leave it empty if you do not know it.
overrides.loadError: The country list for corrections could not be loaded. Please try again later.
overrides.saveError: The correction could not be saved. Please try again.
overrides.deleteError: The correction could not be deleted. Please try again.
overrides.unknownCountry: The server does not know this country. Please choose another one.
overrides.notFound: There is no correction for this country any more — the view is reloading.
overrides.demoForbidden: The demo account cannot save corrections.
overrides.reloadError: Saved, but the passport could not be reloaded. Reload the page to see the new figures.
overrides.excludedExplanation: You took these countries out of the passport. They are missing from every figure until you count them again.
overrides.restoreError: The country could not be counted again. Please try again.
